title: Pure Coach
summary: Coach FIRE Beast-Warrior Xyz and Rank-Up build supported by the Brotherhood of the Fire Fist engine. Coach Soldier Wolfbark revives Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warriors every turn while Coach Captain Bearman turns your Level 4 board into Level 8s for Coach King Giantrainer.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fire Formation - Tenki searches Coach Soldier Wolfbark, Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Bear, or Gorilla on activation.
Coach Soldier Wolfbark revives any Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior from the GY in Defense Position once per turn, generating an instant Rank 4 Xyz or extra body for Bearman.
Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Bear and Gorilla clear an opposing monster or Spell/Trap to Set Tenki or Fire Formation - Tensu directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Wolfbark + Fire Formation - Tensu + Bearman
steps: Activate Fire Formation - Tensu, then Normal Summon Coach Soldier Wolfbark and revive a Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior (Bear, Gorilla, or Dragon) from the GY.
Use Tensu's extra Beast-Warrior Normal Summon to Normal Summon Coach Captain Bearman without Tributing (as a 1300 ATK Level 8).
Activate Bearman's effect to make all Level 4 Beast-Warriors you control become Level 8 until the End Phase, then overlay all three Level 8s into Coach King Giantrainer.
Detach all 3 materials from Giantrainer to draw 3 cards and burn for 800 per monster drawn, then activate Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force to upgrade it into CXyz Coach Lord Ultimatrainer.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Coach King Giantrainer detaches up to 3 materials per turn to draw up to 3 cards, revealing them and burning the opponent for 800 damage for each monster drawn (at the cost of your Battle Phase that turn).
CXyz Coach Lord Ultimatrainer is a 3800 ATK Rank 9 boss that cannot be targeted by card effects and detaches 1 material once per turn to draw 1 card and burn for 800 if it is a monster.

Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King Sets a Fire Formation straight from the Deck on Xyz Summon and negates all non-Beast-Warrior monster effects on the field, while Bujintei Kagutsuchi mills 5 cards on Summon to load the GY for Wolfbark.

summary.title: Support & Restrictions
points: Coach Goblin places 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck during each End Phase to draw 1 card, cycling away dead Rank-Up-Magics or duplicate Formations.
Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Dragon and Rooster recur Fire Formations and search additional Beast-Warriors to keep Wolfbark stocked every turn.
Coach Captain Bearman cannot be used as Xyz Material except for the Xyz Summon of a FIRE Warrior Monster, which Coach King Giantrainer satisfies.

allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Bear: Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior that searches Fire Formation - Tenki and serves as a prime revival target for Coach Soldier Wolfbark.
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Gorilla: Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior that pops Spell/Traps and revives via Wolfbark.
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Dragon: Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior that sets Fire Formation Traps and revives Fire Fists.
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Rooster: Level 3 FIRE Beast-Warrior that searches Fire Fist monsters and swaps Fire Formations.
allow.Fire Formation - Tenki: Continuous Spell that searches Coach Soldier Wolfbark or any Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior.
allow.Fire Formation - Tensu: Continuous Spell that grants an extra Normal Summon of a Beast-Warrior monster each turn (allowing Bearman to be Normal Summoned alongside Wolfbark).
allow.Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force: Ranks up Rank 8 Coach King Giantrainer into Rank 9 CXyz Coach Lord Ultimatrainer.
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger Kin: Rank 4 Beast-Warrior Xyz that sets Fire Formation - Tenki or Tensu from the Deck and negates monster effects.
allow.Bujintei Kagutsuchi: Rank 4 Beast-Warrior Xyz that mills 5 cards to load the GY with targets for Coach Soldier Wolfbark.
